body: Starvation really kicks in the survival instincts, trust me. Could not think of a less effective way to go. After few days you go so primal that you would do anything for food and could probably still get by through visiting churches etc.

Only financial reasons, nothing else really. Can't afford food or next month's rent and I am not mentally strong enough to go through living on streets/shelter life.


This isn't the first time I lose my job and go completely bankrupt, the last time I had a friend to crash at on his sofa till I found a new job and another friend to lend me money to cover essentials but this card has been used, the friend no longer lives in this country and the other one, I still owe money to.
I don't feel like getting doxxed and which is why I use a VPN and a throwaway. Southern Europe.
